name: FCX/NEM Pairs Trade — Z-Score Mean Reversion
description: Pairs trade strategy on FCX vs NEM. Computes the FCX/NEM price ratio z-score (60-day rolling window). Enters long FCX / short NEM when z-score crosses below -2.0, and long NEM / short FCX when z-score crosses above +2.0. Time-based exit after 63 trading days. 15% stop loss. Dollar-neutral sizing (50% per leg).
source:
# FCX/NEM Pairs Trade — Z-Score Mean Reversion
# Signal: 60-day rolling z-score of FCX/NEM price ratio
# Entry: z < -2.0 → long FCX / short NEM; z > +2.0 → short FCX / long NEM
# Exit: time-based after 63 bars, or 15% stop loss
# Sizing: dollar-neutral, 50% per leg

# --- Data (shared context — identical for both assets) ---
fcx_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()
nem_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()

# --- Price Ratio & Z-Score ---
ratio = fcx_ref.c / nem_ref.c
z = zscore(window=60)(ratio)

# --- Signal Detection ---
# z crosses below -2.0: FCX is cheap relative to NEM → long FCX, short NEM
signal_low = crossunder(z, -2.0)
# z crosses above +2.0: FCX is expensive relative to NEM → short FCX, long NEM
signal_high = crossover(z, 2.0)

# --- Per-Asset Direction Routing ---
is_fcx = is_asset_ref(ticker='FCX')()
is_nem = is_asset_ref(ticker='NEM')()

# FCX: long on signal_low (cheap), short on signal_high (expensive)
fcx_long_entry = signal_low and is_fcx
fcx_short_entry = signal_high and is_fcx

# NEM: short on signal_low (FCX cheap = NEM expensive), long on signal_high
nem_long_entry = signal_high and is_nem
nem_short_entry = signal_low and is_nem

# Combined entries per asset context
long_entry = fcx_long_entry or nem_long_entry
short_entry = fcx_short_entry or nem_short_entry

# --- Execution (wiring order: zone → sizing → exits) ---
# Hold for 63 bars (time-based exit), strict_hold ignores opposing signals during hold
long_and_short_zone(hold_long=63, hold_short=63, strict_hold=True)(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Dollar-neutral: 50% of equity per leg
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)

# 15% stop loss on each leg
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=15)
